description: Search the special / VIP mobile numbers (أرقام مميزة) for sale at Baqer Store, Iraq: Zain (زين) and Asiacell (آسياسيل). Filter by operator, ending digits (e.g. "7777"), digits anywhere, prefix (e.g. "0785"), pattern (triple / quad / penta / hexa = a digit repeated 3/4/5/6+ times, mirror = ABBA ending, birth_year = ends with a year), Baqer tier and price range in IQD. Only numbers available now are returned, with price, tier, number page URL and the payment rules (transfer + delivery fee, down payment for expensive numbers).
